title: Random stones
description: This datapack slightly changes the mining process making it a bit less repetitive by adding some random events that can be negative or positive.
body:
# Random stones
Ever found mining in a straight line a little boring ? With this datapack, when mining, you will encounter various types of positive and negative events !
## Positive events :
- You have a small chance of getting nuggets when mining !
- A chest can spawn with loot when mining !
- You have a small chance of getting gole or iron ingots !
## Negative events :
- Zombie / silverfish can spawn on you !
- Some stone blocs can become infected !
